The man is holding a younger baby girl who is dressed in a cream-colored lace cardigan and a green patterned dress. The interior of the cabin is clean and modern with large glass windows. (4) The camera captures the girls leaning against the glass windows, looking out at the sprawling landscape below. The view includes lush green farm fields, clusters of houses, and distant trees under a bright, clear sky. The girls appear excited and curious, pressing their hands against the glass to get a better look at the height. (5) As the ride continues, the man interacts playfully with the girls, holding the younger one securely while the older one sits and talks. The lighting remains bright and natural, filling the cabin with a warm glow. The older girl occasionally looks back at the camera with a look of mischievous joy. (6) The final phase shows the man carrying the older girl out of the Ferris wheel car onto the boarding platform. The camera pans slightly to show the ground before transitioning to a solid pink screen featuring a small cartoon character and the text "POPO'S DAILY LIFE" in white capital letters.
